set.body: Replace metadata-only external fields with a typed FieldSource or equivalent capability and provide a JVM NIfTI-backed implementation that can satisfy planned source demands. Construction, transforms, and selections must remain IO-free; only terminal evaluation opens the source. Acceptance: unavailable or stale sources return typed errors; source geometry and root domain are validated; resources close deterministically; demanded blocks are read once and only as broadly as required; shared source-contract tests run on JVM and JS, with JVM integration fixtures for real NIfTI byte layouts and partial reads.
set.title: Spatial external roots: lazy FieldSource contract and JVM NIfTI block loading
